subject.title: feat: Add local Codex Workspaces analytics

question: Should CodexBar adopt the proposed default in which an unset Workspaces preference inherits the existing local cost-usage preference, while an explicitly set Workspaces preference overrides it?
rationale: This determines upgrade behavior for existing users and creates a new settings contract; code review cannot safely choose that product default without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve staged inheritance default
options.body: Keep compatibility by inheriting the existing local cost-usage setting until a user explicitly chooses the dedicated Workspaces setting, then require fresh-install and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Use an independent opt-in default
options.body: Make Workspaces disabled until users enable its own setting, avoiding inherited activation at the cost of a less seamless existing-user experience.

options.title: Defer the preference contract
options.body: Land no UI follow-up until the desired migration and long-term relationship between local costs and Workspaces is decided.

recommendation.title: Approve staged inheritance default
recommendation.body: Keep compatibility by inheriting the existing local cost-usage setting until a user explicitly chooses the dedicated Workspaces setting, then require fresh-install and upgrade coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level product and upgrade-default decision rather than a narrow mechanical correction.
